title: Persona
description: A ClawkWork persona definition. Compiled to TS by tools/build.ts.

id.description: Stable kebab/snake-case id. Must match the directory name.

version.description: Catalog content version. Missing legacy personas are read as v0.

kind.description: Generalists are broad defaults for a domain and choose workflows/escalations. Specialists have a narrow recurring trigger and known artifact.

use_when.description: Concrete routing triggers. Use this persona when one of these statements matches the user's task.

not_for.description: Adjacent tasks this persona should not absorb; include preferred handoffs when useful.

config.description: Partial<AgentConfig> overrides. Only set fields that differ from defaults.

extra_index_imports.description: Side-effect import paths added to the top of the generated index.ts (only valid for bundled personas — those with a files/ tree). Use to wire hand-written sibling modules like ./tools that register persona-specific tools into the global registry.

seed.description: Optional seed content beyond the files/ tree: hooks, standing orders, and files inherited from another persona's files/ tree. The build emits a per-persona seeder into seeders.ts that calls the matching preset helper for each block.

hooks.description: Preset tool hooks seeded into the agent's tool_hooks table.

orders.description: Preset standing orders seeded as /orders/<slug>.md files plus matching cron jobs.

inherit_files.description: Subsets of another persona's files/ tree mounted into this persona's VFS. Each entry references a source persona by id; the source must define a files/ tree.

from.description: Source persona id (must be a persona with a files/ tree).

paths.description: VFS paths to inherit (must exist in source's emitted FILE_SPECS). Each starts with /.
